name: Caged Bird
source:
Today is the day of the school festival. 

Some people are looking at a certain painting at the art club's exhibition—a painting of a bird in a cage.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/caged-bird]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是学园祭的日子。

有人正在看美术社展览中的某幅画——一幅笼中鸟的画。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/caged-bird]itch.io[/url]]
